history.name: One file per feature
history.description: Each feature is its own small file in the project's repository. A change to one feature is a change to one file, so the record's version history reads as a sequence of legible edits, and two branches that each add a feature don't collide.
history.dev_notes: .ledger/features/<id>.json, loaded by Project#load(); a file whose name doesn't match the id it declares is refused.
